summary: Shared in-band sentinel helpers for set-dimension wildcards: normalize_set_expr, set_wildcard_predicate, canonicalize_set_expr, plus reservation/null-element validators. Exported API and behavior are unchanged this revision; only validate_set_no_null_elements's docstring was updated to name the filter engine's new list-membership primitive.
lifecycle_notes: This module already existed at the accepted baseline. Its only change in this window updates validate_set_no_null_elements's docstring from t_is_in to list.t_contains; executable helpers and signatures are unchanged.

evidence.detail: 'Set-dimension wildcards use the in-band [sentinel] list (not null)...'
validate_set_no_null_elements docstring: '``list.t_contains`` tolerates a null element (it matches nothing)...' (previously named ``t_is_in``)
